name: Worker
text: Good morning, Itachi! Nice weather today, isn't it?

name: Itachi
text: It certainly is. How are things going around town?

name: Worker
text: Not bad, but the old bridge near the river is starting to look worn out.

name: Itachi
text: I've noticed that too. Has it been causing problems?

name: Worker
text: A few travelers have complained about it. It might hurt tourism if we leave it too long.

name: Itachi
text: That's good to know. I'll see if we can set aside funds for repairs.

name: Worker
text: The townsfolk would appreciate that. A safer bridge means more visitors.

name: Itachi
text: Anything else the town needs right now?

name: Worker
text: Some fresh flowers near the station would make a great first impression.

name: Itachi
text: I like that idea. Let's make our town even more welcoming.
